body: macOS M4 (edit and undo): pass on the task, with three findings.U+000AU+000AU+002D Pass: double-click selects a word, typing replaces it and keeps bold; Undo/Redo toolbar buttons, Cmd+Z and Cmd+Shift+Z all work; clicking the checkbox ticks it and keeps focus; Save changes persists `**high**` and `- [x]` (reopened source identical); Cancel on an unchanged note closes with no prompt.U+000AU+002D Hurts: the menu bar Edit > Undo and Redo are disabled (enabled=false) while the editor has undo history; Edit > Paste and Edit > Select All do nothing (source, selection and the probe's text-input trace unchanged), while Cmd+V and Cmd+A work at the same caret. Edit > Copy works (puts the visible text plus RTF on the clipboard). A stock Flutter TextField (Search) behaves the same: menu Paste inserts nothing, Cmd+V pastes. So this is app-wide at the Flutter macOS text-input layer, driven through AX menu presses; a real mouse pick from the Edit menu is an owner hand check. Evidence m4_search_menu_paste.png.U+000AU+002D Hurts: after Cancel then "Keep editing" on the Discard dialog, the editor has no focus (focused=false) and typed letters are dropped until the user clicks into the text. Reproduced twice. Evidence m4_after_keep_editing.png.U+000AU+002D c5 finding 3 (Ctrl+K): CONFIRMED. In the note editor, caret at 16 in "Keep this part, delete the rest", Ctrl+K reaches the app (KeyDown Control+K logged) and changes nothing (m5c_ctrl_k.png). The stock Search TextField also ignores Ctrl+K while Ctrl+A and Ctrl+D work there, so it is Flutter-level (deleteToEndOfParagraph: unmapped), user-visible everywhere.
